name: Shindrell's Note
summary: In Astranaar, Shindrell Swiftfire sends word of corruption near town and along Ashenvale's coast. Her report travels east through the forest to Kayneth Stillwind.

sections.title: A Missive Across the Woods
sections.body:
Sentinels and druids watch Ashenvale's borders together as unrest spreads through the forest. From Astranaar, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire reports troubling disturbances along the western coast and among the central canopies.

Her report is addressed to Kayneth Stillwind, a druid at the shrine of Forest Song in the Nightsong Woods to the east. Couriers carry Shindrell's firsthand observations to aid his search for corruption in the sacred groves.

faq.answer: Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire's field report describes disturbances and suspected corruption near Astranaar and along Ashenvale's coastline.

faq.q: Who is meant to receive the note?
aliases: who do I give this to
faq.answer: The note is addressed to Kayneth Stillwind, a night elf druid at Forest Song in the Nightsong Woods in eastern Ashenvale.

aliases: what corruption is shindrell talking about
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind feared corruption was taking root in the western forests and asked for reports of unusual occurrences. Shindrell gathered her sightings to help him judge the threat.
Shindrell Swiftfire is a night elf sentinel stationed at Astranaar, a settlement in central Ashenvale.

angles.text: Sentinels defending Ashenvale's settlements work with Cenarion druids studying the forest's sickness.
Shindrell's observations help Kayneth Stillwind and his fellow druids uncover the roots of the unnatural blight troubling Ashenvale.
